|game_text=Deploy on Sidious. If at Senate, at start of your turn may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5)]]. Other errata versions: [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-25-With_Thunderous_Applause-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-25-With_Thunderous_Applause.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-withthunderousapplause-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5)]].
* '''Original''' ([[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) moved “if at Senate” to the front: “At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw” became “If at Senate, at start of your turn may draw”. PC-E1 text: “Deploy on Sidious. If at Senate, at start of your turn may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”<ref name="cl-1250_22-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) restored the printed “At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw” and changed “loses all immunity to attrition” to “loses any immunity to attrition”. PC-E2 text: “Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses any immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this text on its rules forum on 26 August 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p644156">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 26 August 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p644156 forum post])</ref>. That is earlier than the first archived copy of the card-list wording (PC-E1, 21 July 2012), whose own date is not known.
